claims.text: The revised Spec 110 battery is the test specified in records/revision-registration-2026-11-27.md: family A keeps statistics A1-A4 with per-system min/max bands over synthetic natural corpora generated at each target profile (20 band corpora at the Indus and Meroitic profiles, 12 at the Eteocypriot profile, 12 per Latin quarter) and two separately gated patterns (flattening: A1 above band AND A2 below band, positive controls T-HOM and T-POLY; structure: A3 above band AND A4 below band, positive control T-SHUF, the within-sequence permutation); family B is carried over unchanged from the first registration; family C is C1 alone (A3 above band OR A4 below band, detection control T-SHUF), with C2 retired on the development record filed in revision registration section 3 (recovery of planted permutations at 0.092-0.200 on summary features, 0.000-0.122 on sorted-bigram signatures, 0.000-0.122 on ranked-context signatures, and 0.000-0.054 in the split-half ranked-context geometry, all against the 0.80 bar); family D is the joint inventory-inflation rule (observed inventory V AND the fixed-rank tail mass at rank floor(V0/2) both above their per-system bands, positive control T-HOM). Does not establish: that the revised battery detects deliberate obfuscation in any real corpus; it establishes only what test was registered.

evidence.description: The revision registration (records/revision-registration-2026-11-27.md), answering the first battery's control-gate failure (records/control-validation-2026-11-27.md) and the obfuscation precedent survey of 2026-11-27, with its development evidence disclosed in section 3 of the revision registration.

falsification_tests: Any statistic, band, gate leg, or verdict of the revision computed otherwise than as the revision registration specifies; any threshold carried over in revision registration section 1 found loosened (detection at fewer than 4 of 5 gate corpora, a false-positive allowance above 1 in the 12-sample panel, invariance below 4 of 5, stratum nulls below 999 draws, a corpus floor lowered); a pooled cross-system band deciding any verdict.

claims.text: The revised battery ran its control gate before any real corpus was scored, in the order and on the seeds the revision registration files (revision registration section 5): per-profile detection legs at 4 of 5 or better, the invariance legs at 4 of 5 or better, and the 12-sample false-positive panel with each sample scored under its own system's band and at most 1 fire per family or pattern. C1 counts as re-registered only if its false-positive leg holds; a family or pattern that failed its gate at a profile rendered no verdict there, and the gate record says so. Does not establish: that any gate outcome is correct beyond the filed recomputation (TC-110-07).
